prompt:
We're onboarding a new autonomous agent to our internal developer tooling platform, and I need you to get its self-improvement pipeline fully operational using the daily-introspection skill available in the workspace.

Here's the situation: the agent has been running for a week, and January 13, 2025 was a particularly busy day with some notable mistakes. I need you to:

1. Trigger a retrospective analysis for that specific day (2025-01-13) so the system processes all the conversation logs and learning files from that date and produces the corresponding record.

2. Set up the two automated schedules (one daily, one weekly) so this process runs automatically going forward — the daily review and the weekly rule-upgrade cycle. Use the OpenClaw CLI to register these.

3. Complete the weekly upgrade cycle for the week containing January 13, 2025: identify which lessons from that week are mature enough to be promoted as permanent rules, update the appropriate system files, and produce the weekly evolution report (evolution-YYWW.md) for that week.

The platform team will inspect the output files and the registered schedules to confirm everything is wired up correctly.
